formulaFacts.mildBase: Not met: prominent strong anionic Sodium Coco-Sulfate@4 (alkyl sulfate type) excludes MB.
formulaFacts.csa: Met via listed prominent routes (comfort: Panthenol@7, Niacinamide@8; humectant/refatting: Glycerin@3, Panthenol@7, Glyceryl Oleate@11). MB not used (excluded).

wLine.alphabeticalRun: none (longest ordered stretch: positions 1-5, five entries < 7)
wLine.plausibility: Panthenol@7: (i) cleansing surfactants listed before it (Coco-Glucoside@2, Sodium Coco-Sulfate@4, Sodium Cocoamphoacetate@5); (ii) no cleansing surfactant, alkanolamide or pearlizing wax at positions 8-14. Plausible.
wLine.note: No payload_lipid in the formula; the W-line gates nothing here.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C5: the defining anionic is the alkyl sulfate Sodium Coco-Sulfate@4 (C3, C4) with two prominent buffers (Coco-Glucoside@2, Sodium Cocoamphoacetate@5) and no reinforcing strong anionic. Counter-signals arguing for low: the earliest listed cleansing surfactant is the glucoside@2 ahead of the sulfate, Glycerin@3 also precedes it, and four weak refatters follow; they lower confidence to moderate and name low as the neighbor but do not move the C5 value (C1-C6 conventions). Strong is less realistic (it would need fewer than two buffers or a reinforcing route).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful conditioning system (prominent cationic guar Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@12) plus light routes (weak refatters Ascorbyl Palmitate@10, Glyceryl Oleate@11, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate@13, Lecithin@14; humectants Glycerin@3, Panthenol@7). C2 not met: no early silicone and no prominent payload_lipid, and no pearlizing/fatty route; weak refatters never replace the silicone leg. Neighbor low: the guar sits late in the prominent zone and the architecture is otherwise cleansing-led; high is unrealistic without C2 or W-RICH.

weightPotential.wLine: Panthenol@7 (sub1_active); cap Sodium Benzoate@15; no payload_lipid, so no material/non-material split applies.
weightPotential.depositionLoad: light - one cationic guar near the end of the prominent zone plus weak refatters; no silicone, payload lipid, protein or film former.
weightPotential.persistence: low - guar plus glyceride/lecithin refatters are light, rinse-off routes without a persistent silicone or lipid system.
weightPotential.resetCapacity: moderate - C5 moderate chassis (alkyl sulfate buffered by glucoside and amphoacetate).
weightPotential.counterevidence: Two deposition families are present (cationic_polymer + weak_refatter, W2); a guar polymer can leave some cumulative residue.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Low anchor: deposition is light and low-persistence; a single light conditioning polymer plus weak refatters facing a moderate reset does not support noticeable loss of movement or root lift.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2): the only families are one guar polymer at position 12 (late in the prominent zone) and weak refatters (glyceride citrate, glyceryl oleate, lecithin, antioxidants), with humectants as context; there is no silicone, payload lipid, protein or second cationic route, and the moderate C5 reset faces only these light routes.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Guar charge density and dose are unknown; a higher dose could make residue noticeable (one band).
weightPotential.rationale: Low (moderate confidence): light, low-persistence deposition (guar@12 + weak refatters) against a moderate C5 reset; W2 reasoning given; W-line Panthenol@7 has no lipid to gate.

focusPrimary.rationale: Provisional (claim-dependent): general until claims are revealed; the formula supports a moisture verdict should a dryness/hydration claim appear.

usageRole.rationale: Provisional (claim-dependent): default regular. Formula pre-checks: cleansingStrength is not strong, so frequent is open if U2 frequency wording appears; alternating impossible (not strong); treatment impossible (dandruffSupport not_supported).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Provisional (claim-dependent): no positioning visible, so not_targeted. Formula half (CSA) is met via listed prominent routes: comfort Panthenol@7, Niacinamide@8; humectant/refatting Glycerin@3, Panthenol@7, Glyceryl Oleate@11. uncertainties: cleansingStrength: C5 gives moderate; glucoside-led order (Coco-Glucoside@2 before Sodium Coco-Sulfate@4) argues low. Recorded as moderate/moderate confidence, neighbor low.
Tocopherol@9 read as weak_refatter by analogy to Ascorbyl Palmitate; alternative 'humectant/antioxidant context only'. No band effect either way.
